subject: Buyer signoff sequence & pricing snapshot for AWS Marketplace private offer
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@healthbridge.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@healthbridge.com>
Cc: James Green <james.green@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Buyer signoff sequence & pricing snapshot for AWS Marketplace private offer

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a short pricing snapshot (pricing_grid.xlsx) that shows:
- 12-month subscription (annualized)
- 36-month blended rate (3-year commitment with consumption overlay)
- Month-to-month usage overage rates and activation credits

Two asks from your side to move toward a private offer:
1) Confirm the internal approver roster (procurement -> legal -> CFO signoff threshold). In our experience the CFO typically needs to sign for deals > $250k; if your threshold is lower we can route for CFO earlier.
2) Confirm desired term (12 vs 36 months) so we can lock pricing and propose activation date.

If helpful, I can send a pre-populated PO template and an internal note for your procurement team showing who needs to sign and by when. Would a 30-minute call on Wednesday work to finalize approvers?

Next steps we plan on our side: queue the private offer in AWS once approvers are confirmed, capture the PO template (for your procurement), and hold a 1-hour onboarding kickoff once the PO is returned.

Attachments: pricing_grid.xlsx

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@healthbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@healthbridge.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Buyer signoff sequence & pricing snapshot for AWS Marketplace private offer

Neha —

Thanks for the summary and the grid. A couple quick clarifications from procurement:
1) Can you provide the approver matrix you typically send to customers? We need a clear flow we can paste into our internal ticket.
2) What exactly triggers CFO review at your side? Our internal threshold for CFO is $150k (not $250k) — that will affect timing.
3) Please attach the PO template and any example terms we should expect in the private offer (billing cadence, termination language, auto-renewal).

Tom — I looped you so you can flag any procurement constraints. We can jump on Wed but earlier would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Senior Procurement Manager | HealthBridge Medical Systems
alicia.moreno@healthbridge.com
+1 (212) 555-0137

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@healthbridge.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@healthbridge.com>
Cc: James Green <james.green@amazon.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Buyer signoff sequence & pricing snapshot for AWS Marketplace private offer

Hi Alicia —

Attached: PO_template.pdf (simple PO with line items and billing cadence) and a one-page approver matrix below you can drop into a ticket.

Approver matrix (recommended):
- Procurement Analyst (initial PO intake / budget check)
- Procurement Lead (negotiates payment cadence / invoice recipient)
- Legal (terms redline / indemnity questions)
- Finance (payment terms / invoicing schedule)
- CFO (threshold: $150k and above)

Notes on private offer structure:
- Billing cadence: annual or monthly-in-advance depending on term (we can set up annual invoicing through AWS Marketplace or direct invoice after activation).
- Term length: 12-months (standard) or 36-months (discounted). For 36-month we propose a blended discount that combines an annual commit with a modest consumption buffer; details in pricing_grid.xlsx.
- Auto-renew: off by default for marketplace private offers; language included in PO_template.pdf.

On the CFO threshold — thank you for confirming $150k. That means we should expect CFO to sign if the initial PO or expected TCV is above that amount. I can flag this in our internal deal tracker (DEAL-8921) and loop Vanessa for any approval exceptions.

Would you be able to confirm the approver names for each role? If so, we will issue the private offer to the AWS account (James) and attach the PO for signature.

Best,
Neha

Subject: Fwd: Buyer signoff sequence & pricing snapshot for AWS Marketplace private offer (internal: discount request)

Vanessa / Vivek —

Forwarding the procurement note from HealthBridge. They confirmed a $150k CFO threshold (lower than standard). Deal here: HB-2028-0720-01 (DEAL-8921). Proposed offer is a 36-month blended for $420k TCV with an activation credit applied in year one.

Ask: can we approve a 12% blended discount on the 36-month structure to hold this price through August 15? Need an exception sign-off to lock on AWS private offer pricing. Attached pricing_calc_v2.xlsx shows the margin impact.

If yes, we'll:
- Create private offer draft in AWS and pre-populate approver details;
- Send PO_template.pdf to HealthBridge for signature;
- Schedule onboarding for week of Aug 7.

Timing is tight — procurement wants a signed PO within 2 weeks. Appreciate quick eyes.

Thanks,
Neha
